# Run book: Store texts and find the closest

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/store-and-search-vectors.md) | [Spec](../specs/store-and-search-vectors.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)
- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

The vector store interface hides where vectors live, so the same code runs on SQL Server, Qdrant or in memory and ranks by meaning instead of keywords.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Store texts and find the closest"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/utilities/vectors`:

1. **Store the sample texts.** Four sentences are filled in, two about pets and two about money. Store them in the notes collection. Expect: A line reports how many texts were stored and in which store.
2. **Search by meaning.** The query a sleeping pet shares no words with the stored sentences but is close to the cat and kitten ones. Expect: The closest sentences are listed first with their distance.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Search returns nothing | The collection is empty or holds vectors of a different length | Press Store texts first, and keep one embedding model per collection |
| Stored in the memory store | No SqlVectorStoreOptions:ConnectionString is configured, so the in-process store is used and is lost on restart | Deploy OoBDev.Data.Vectors.DB and set the connection string to keep vectors in SQL Server |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Search.Abstractions (`IVectorStore`); OoBDev.Data.Vectors.SqlStore (`SqlVectorStoreProvider`); OoBDev.SBert.AllMiniLmL6V2 (embeddings).
